hero_controls._how: Landing hero positioning (Franc). pos = focal point (x% y%); scale above 1 zooms in around origin (x% y%), so an origin left of Isenathi pushes her right and larger; label-lift raises the title label. 'lap' is 960 and wider, 'phone' below. label_lap: 'top-right' sets the title label high on the right (default: low left). label_top_lap: how far down the hero the top-right label starts.
